thread:
jane_marketing: Hey team — planning to announce adaptive batching tomorrow. Need: final changelog, docs link, benchmark numbers (including p99), and exact rollout time. Can eng confirm? :wave:

sam_engineering: Pushing final changelog edits now. Snippet: `- adaptive batching: up to 3x throughput for small requests; - improved KV cache reuse: ~20% token-cost reduction; - backward-compatible API`
Docs (staging): https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/adaptive-batching (behind flag). ETA final commit a1b2c3d in ~20m.

nate_content: For blog: can we include workload notes (chat vs completion), p99 latency, and cost per 1k tokens? Also want to schedule a short webinar next month — will sync after rollout.

alina_prod: Suggest soft-doc publicification first, then announce once canary green. Messaging: "same API, lower cost" + safe fallback note. Avoid raw percent claims without context.

sam_engineering: Quick bench (chat-like, 512 context, batch=16): median 120ms, p99 430ms, token-cost reduction 18–22% depending on prompt. Bench artifacts: https://ci.redwood.ai/artifacts/bench/adaptive-batching-17902. We can add a one-paragraph methods blurb for the blog.

cam_ops: Canary plan tomorrow 10:00-12:00 PT: 10% -> 50% @11:00 -> 100% by 11:45 if green. Fallback toggle ready. We'll post status here.

jane_marketing: Can marketing set an embargo? If canary is green, announce at 12:15 PT to give time for socials/email. Webinar invites next week. @nate_content please prepare headline options.

nate_content: Headline options: 1) "Reduce inference costs with adaptive batching" 2) "Same API, faster responses and lower token costs". Will draft tweet thread and email subject variants.

sam_engineering: Docs behind flag now; will flip public after canary. I'll also drop a short rollback runbook so support/sales can react. Methods blurb: "Benchmarks run on p4d, 512-token chat workloads, continuous batching vs non-batched baseline." Changelog commit: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/commit/a1b2c3d

cam_ops: Deploy bot scheduled the canary: `deploy-bot: scheduled deploy adaptive-batching canary at 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z` :robot_face:

deploy-bot: Canary started 2026-03-21T17:00:00Z, 10% traffic. Monitoring: latency-dashboard, errors-log, e2e-smoke.

alina_prod: For inbound leads route early demo requests to sales@redwood.ai with tag `adaptive-batching-early` and ping solutions-eng. Prepare short FAQ about limits.

jane_marketing: Final asks: @sam_engineering drop final changelog + methods paragraph here; @cam_ops confirm 100% and docs public time; @nate_content finalize headline + first tweet. I'll queue blog/social/email once links are in. :thumbsup:

sam_engineering: Final changelog & methods posted (see commit link).

cam_ops: Canary reached 100% at 11:47 PT, docs public at 12:05 PT. Monitoring green. Rolling closed.

jane_marketing: Announcing at 12:15 PT. Queuing blog, social, and email. Will ping when live. :rocket:

sam_engineering: Congrats team — ping if any post-launch issues. :tada:
